question.en: Pradnya invests ₹2,00,000 in the name of her daughter, who is 16 years old, in a scheme that pays compound interest at a rate of 8% per annum, compounded annually. What will be the total amount due to the daughter when she becomes 18 years old?
question.hi: प्रदन्या ने अपनी 16 साल की बेटी के नाम पर ₹2,00,000 का निवेश एक ऐसी योजना में किया, जिसमें 8% की वार्षिक दर पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दिया जाता है, जो वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। जब उसकी बेटी 18 वर्ष की हो जाएगी तो बेटी को प्राप्त होने वाली कुल धनराशि कितनी होगी?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**₹2,33,280**).

optionTrick.en: Use 2-yr factor $\frac{729}{625}$ or effective rate **16.64%** of 2,00,000 $\Rightarrow \mathbf{Rs.2,33,280}$!

steps.hi: 2 वर्ष की कुल ब्याज दर 16.64% से सीधा उत्तर **₹2,33,280** मिलता है!

solution.en:
Method 1: Ratio-Multiplier Method (27/25): 1) 8% annual factor $= \frac{27}{25}$ over 2 years $\Rightarrow \frac{729}{625}$.
2) $A = 200000 \times \frac{729}{625} = 2,33,280.00$. (**₹2,33,280**).

Method 2: Effective 2-Yr Rate (2R + R²/100): Net 2-yr CI rate $= 16.64\%$. Multiply 1.1664 by 2,00,000 $\Rightarrow \mathbf{Rs.2,33,280}$!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option A (**4**).
solution.keyConcept: Collinear Segment Condition: B lies on AC <=> AB + BC = AC
solution.en:
Method 1: Segment Addition Formula: $(k + 3) + 2k = 5k - 5 \Rightarrow 3k + 3 = 5k - 5 \Rightarrow 2k = 8 \Rightarrow k = \mathbf{4}$.

Method 2: Direct Coefficient Jump (3 sec): $(5k - 3k) = 3 + 5 \Rightarrow 2k = 8 \Rightarrow k = \mathbf{4}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: रेखाखंड योग नियम: $(k + 3) + 2k = 5k - 5 \Rightarrow 2k = 8 \Rightarrow k = \mathbf{4}$।

विधि 2: गुणांक अंतर ट्रिक: $(5k - 3k) = 3 + 5 \Rightarrow k = \mathbf{4}$!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option A (**₹1,31,220**).

optionTrick.en: Fraction factor $= \frac{9}{10}$ (2 yrs $= \frac{81}{100}$), or net 2-yr change $= -19\%$ $\Rightarrow \mathbf{Rs.1,31,220}$!

title.hi: विधि 2: शुद्ध क्रमिक प्रतिशत / इकाई अंक ट्रिक

steps.en: Net 2-yr change $= -19\%$. Apply directly to 162000 gives **₹1,31,220**!

solution.en:
Method 1: 2-Year Growth/Depreciation Formula: 1) Annual factor $= 1 - 10\% = \frac{9}{10}$.
2) After 2 years: $V = 162000 \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{9}{10} = \mathbf{1,31,220}$ (₹1,31,220).

Method 2: Net Successive % / Unit-Digit Check: Net 2-yr change $= -19\%$. Apply directly to 162000 gives **₹1,31,220**!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: 2-वर्ष चक्रवृद्धि सूत्र: 1) वार्षिक गुणक $= \frac{9}{10}$।
2) 2 वर्ष बाद मान $= 162000 \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{9}{10} = \mathbf{1,31,220}$ (₹1,31,220)।

विधि 2: शुद्ध क्रमिक प्रतिशत / इकाई अंक ट्रिक: 2 वर्ष का शुद्ध परिवर्तन $= -19\%$ लगाने पर सीधा **₹1,31,220** आता है!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**12**).
solution.keyConcept: Next Square After 6072: Bracket Near 75² = 5625 and 80² = 6400

optionTrick.en: A perfect square ends in `0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 9` (`NEVER 2, 3, 7, 8`)! Add options to `6072`: `+16 -> 8`, `+12 -> 4`, `+10 -> 2`, `+6 -> 8`!! **ONLY `+12` (`6084`) avoids forbidden unit digits `2` & `8`!**

title.en: Method 2: Forbidden Square Unit Digit Trick (3 sec)

steps.en: No perfect square ever ends in `2, 3, 7, 8`! Test last digit of `6072 + option`: `2+16=..8✗`, `2+12=..4✓`, `2+10=..2✗`, `2+6=..8✗` $\Rightarrow$ **12** in 3 seconds!

solution.en:
Method 1: Locate Next Perfect Square (78²): 1) $77^2 = 5929 < 6072 < 78^2$.
2) Compute $78^2 = (80 - 2)^2 = 6400 - 320 + 4 = 6084$.
3) Least number to add $= 6084 - 6072 = \mathbf{12}$.

Method 2: Forbidden Square Unit Digit Trick (3 sec): No perfect square ever ends in `2, 3, 7, 8`! Test last digit of `6072 + option`: `2+16=..8✗`, `2+12=..4✓`, `2+10=..2✗`, `2+6=..8✗` $\Rightarrow$ **12** in 3 seconds!
